title: Anna's Trips
text:
Anna lives in a small town. Every morning she takes the bus to work. The bus is green and it is always full. The trip takes twenty minutes.

On Saturday, Anna goes to the train station. She buys a ticket to the city. The train is fast and comfortable. Anna likes to look out of the window.

questions.text: Where does Anna go on Saturday?
Why might Anna prefer the train to the bus?
How does Anna probably feel about her Saturday trip?

vocabulary.definition: a large vehicle that carries many passengers along a road
a small paper or card that allows you to travel
pleasant to sit in or use, without pain or discomfort
a place where trains stop so people can get on and off

paragraph_translations: Anna mora em uma cidade pequena. Todas as manhãs ela pega o ônibus para o trabalho. O ônibus é verde e está sempre cheio. A viagem dura vinte minutos.
No sábado, Anna vai à estação de trem. Ela compra uma passagem para a cidade. O trem é rápido e confortável. Anna gosta de olhar pela janela.
